mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image (image_name, image_file, is_public, is_deleted, image_type, image_contents, image_date, image_reg_date, coord_point_id, user_id) VALUES (#{imageName}, #{imageFile}, #{isPublic}, #{isDeleted}, #{imageType}, #{imageContent}, #{imageDate}, #{imageRegDate}, #{coordPoint.coordinatePointId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, cp.*, sgg.sgg_id, sgg.sgg_name, sd.sd_id, sd.sd_name FROM image i LEFT JOIN coord_poi cp ON i.coord_point_id = cp.coord_point_id LEFT JOIN juso_sigungu sgg ON cp.sgg_id = sgg.sgg_id LEFT JOIN juso_sido sd ON sgg.sd_id = sd.sd_id WHERE i.image_id = #{imageId} AND i.is_deleted = 0

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM album_image ai WHERE ai.image_id = i.image_id AND ai.album_id = #{excludeAlbumId} )
